caption: Säntis, Schwägalp
composition: Schwägalp pastures looking toward the Säntis, with the cableway out of service · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Schwägalp pastures in Hundwil, Appenzell Ausserrhoden, the Säntis rises as a steep limestone massif. The summit is the tripoint with Appenzell Innerrhoden and St. Gallen, while the path and the valley station stay on the Ausserrhoden side. The Schwägalp–Säntis cableway is closed for renewal from May through late autumn 2026, so the frame shows the mountain and the alp without a passenger cabin and without an invented works yard. Late-September pasture is green to tawny, and the Open-Meteo model is the alp cell, not the summit.
